test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six girls K, L, M, N, O and P are sitting in a straight line facing north. L is between P and K. O is third to the left of K. N is third to right of L. K is to the immediate left of M. M is between K and N. Who is sitting between O and L?
solution: **People**: K, L, M, N, O, P (facing north) 1) O seats third to the left of K and K is to the immediate left of M. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d30c95df119bc63049abc3570bef8a829d3e89a481dbb9a6324cf83bef51b720.png]
